spans.s: श्रु (I) vt. 1P (pres. श्रवति) To go, to move.

श्रु (II) vt. 5P (pp. श्रुत; pres. शृणोति; pass. श्रूयते) 1. To hear, to listen to, to give ear to, कथमालि शृणोषि सादरं विपरीतार्थविदो हि योषितः Bh.V.ii.177, श्रोष्यत्यस्मात् परमहिता Megh.ii.37, R.i.10; 2. to be obedient, to obey.With अनु-, to hear, M.ix.100.With अभि-, to listen, to hear.With आ-, to promise, (with the dat. of the person to whom the promise is made).With उपा-, 1. to hear, to listen; 2. to learn from, केशिना हृतामुर्वशीं नारदादुपश्रुत्य Vikr.i.With प्रति-, to promise, (with the dat. of the person to whom the promise is made), प्रतिश्रुश्राव काकुत्स्थस्तेभ्यो विघ्नप्रतिक्रियाम् R.xv.4.With सम्-, (Atm. when used intransitively) to hear, to listen to, हितान्न यः संशृणुते स किं प्रभुः Kir.i.5.
श्रु Caus. (श्रावयति-ते) to recite to, to communicate.
श्रु Desid. (शुश्रूषते) 1. to desire to hear; 2. to obey, to be obedient to; 3. to wait upon, शुश्रूषस्व गुरून् कुरु प्रियसखीवृत्तिं सपत्नीजने Sak.iv.

स्रु vt. or vi. 1P (pp. स्रुत; pres. स्रवति) 1. To flow, to stream, to ooze, to drop, to exude, शोणितं चाप्यसुस्रुवत् Bt.xv.56; 2. to move, to go; 3. to let flow, to shed; 4. to trickle away, to slip away, to perish, धैर्यं नस्तव हेतोरसुस्रुवन् Bt.vi.18; 5. to spread about, to transpire.
स्रु Caus. (स्रावयति-ते) to cause to flow, to pour out, to shed, to spill, न गात्रात्स्रावयेदसृक् M.iv.169.
स्रू f. 1. A sacrificial ladle; 2. a cascade.
श्रुघ्निका f. Natron, alkali.
श्रुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Heard, listened to; 2. heard of; 3. well-known, reputed; 4. understood, ascertained.
श्रुत (II) n. 1. The object of hearing; 2. the Veda, revelation, श्रुतप्रकाशं यशसा प्रकाशः R.v.2; 3. learning in general, श्रुतस्य यायादयमंतमर्भकः R.iii.21, v.22, Bt.x.1.
श्रुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Heard, listened to; 2. heard of; 3. well-known, reputed; 4. understood, ascertained.
स्रुत a. (generally at the end of a compound) Flowing, distilling, अमृतस्रुतोऽपि विरहाद्भवतः Sis.ix.68.
श्रुत-अध्ययन n. study of the Vedas.
श्रुत-अर्थ m. a fact orally communicated.
श्रुत-कीर्ति m. 1. a divine sage; 2. a generous man.
श्रुत-देवी f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.

श्रुति f. 1. Hearing, श्रुतिमभिनयि Sak.i.; 2. the ear, विहाय भृंगाः श्रुतिहारिनिस्वनाः Rt.ii.14; 3. rumour, report, intelligence; 4. a quarter tone or interval (in music), Sis.xi.1; 5. a sound in general; 6. that which was revealed, i.e. the Veda; (see under वेद); 7. a Vedic text; 8. the constellation Śrāvaṇa.
स्रुति f. 1. Oozing, distilling, अमृतलवस्रुतिशालिभिर्मयूखैः Kir.v.44; 2. exudation, resin, ये तत्क्षीरस्रुतिसुरभयो दक्षिणेन प्रवृत्ताः Megh.ii.44; 3. a stream.
श्रुति-अनुप्रास m. a kind of alliteration.
श्रुति-उक्त, -उदित a. enjoined by the Vedas.
श्रुति-उक्त, -उदित a. enjoined by the Vedas.
श्रुति-कट m. 1. a snake; 2. penance, expiation.
श्रुति-कटु m. a harsh sound (regarded as a fault in rhetoric).
श्रुति-चोदन n. a Vedic precept.
श्रुति-चोदना f. a Vedic precept.
श्रुति-जीविका f. a code of laws.
श्रुति-द्वैध n. contradiction of two Vedic texts.
श्रुति-निदर्शन n. the evidence of revelation.
श्रुति-प्रामाण्य n. the authority of the Veda.
श्रुति-मूल n. the root of the ear, कापि कपोलतले मिलिता लपितुं किमपि श्रुतिमूले Git.G.i.
श्रुति-मूलक a. founded on the Veda.
श्रुति-विषय m. 1. sound, the object of the sense of hearing; 2. the subject matter of the Vedas; 3. the reach of the ear, e.g. श्रुतिविषयमापतितमेव; 4. the ear.
श्रुति-वेध m. the boring of the ear.
श्रुति-स्मृति f. du. the Veda and the institutes of law.
श्रुव m. A sacrifice.
श्रुवा f. A sacrificial ladle.
स्रुव m. A sacrificial ladle.
स्रुवा f. A sacrificial ladle.
श्रुवा-वृक्ष m. the Vikankata tree.
स्रुघ्न m. Name of a district, न हि देवदत्तः स्रुध्रे संनिधीयमानस्तदहरेव पाटलिपुत्रे सन्निधीयते S.Bh.ii.1.7.
स्रुघ्नी f. Natron.
स्रुच् f. A sort of wooden ladle, used for pouring clarified butter on sacrificial fire; (it ought to be made of certain trees only), ऋत्विजां च्युतविकंकतस्रुचाम् R.xi.25.
स्रुक्प्रणालिका f. the spout of a ladle.
